scope: Independent bounded source crosscheck of training audit PORT-9 and PORT-10; no additional implementation scope.

checks.finding: Active MPS vector finalization infers row validity from whether all float Hessians are zero; CUDA vector finalization replays the sampler decision.
checks.exact_source_witness: A vector-tree row with subsample=1 and Hessians[0,0] is selected by CUDA SamplingInfo::kNone (probability1); MPS xgb_leaf_positions marks it invalid and writes ~node.
checks.required_narrowing: Keep vector final-position validity separate from scalar validity. CUDA scalar EncodeOp deliberately tests quantized Hessian!=0 (updater_gpu_hist.cuh:51-56); do not replace that scalar policy with vector sampling semantics.
checks.acceptance_focus: No-sampling, uniform and gradient-based vector sampler decisions, including selected zero-Hessian rows and reduced split/value gradients; GPU positions must preserve exact sampler membership.
checks.limits: Static deterministic source witness and active dispatch trace; no fresh device test, build, suite or NVIDIA execution in this crosscheck.

checks.finding: Numeric selected cut lookup and first-bin -infinity materialization occur in CUDA kernels but in the MPS host evaluator. The categorical OHE lookup/bit operation already has a GPU implementation.
checks.categorical_reason: BuildSplitCategories already reads the selected cut, converts its category ID and sets the bit on GPU. Scalar CUDA UpdateCat sets fvalue=NaN; scalar ExpandCategorical does not consume MPS split_value. Shared vector model expansion discards batch.conds for categorical nodes and writes DftBadValue on host for both CUDA and MPS. Thus the additional host OHE split_value/partition NaN is redundant control metadata, not a missing categorical lookup kernel.
checks.required_narrowing: Rename/scope PORT-10 to selected numeric threshold materialization. Preserve categorical regression guards but remove the missing-OHE-category-operation claim. Persistent selected category payload storage remains PORT-2.
checks.acceptance_focus: GPU-selected numeric threshold matches source cut/previous-cut/-infinity semantics for scalar/vector missing directions, first bins, ties and invalid candidates. Host launch descriptors and source-defined selected metadata publication remain allowed.
checks.limits: Source-only location/consumer check; no numerical regression or NVIDIA runtime claim. This correction does not close the separate numeric GPU placement gap.
